finding.summary: When q.dtype != torch.bfloat16: Any query dtype other than bfloat16 (float32, float64, float16 is fine) is silently treated as float16 in the Triton kernel, so a float32 model runs the sparse kernel in half precision without any check or cast of the inputs. (minference/ops/pit_sparse_flash_attention.py:150)

code.snippet: dtype = tl.bfloat16 if q.dtype == torch.bfloat16 else tl.float16

analysis.tier_note: the probes confirm what the Finding says
analysis.reasoning: Line 150 directly selects tl.float16 for every q.dtype except torch.bfloat16, so float32/float64/float16 queries all enter the Triton kernel as fp16. The shown evidence does not include any explicit non-bf16 check or input cast, and no paper evidence is recorded. This supports the finding, though the absence of checks elsewhere is only inferred from the cited line.
